open_items: ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern, most recently at cycle 1450, recovered by cycle 1451 and healthy through cycle 1456 (6 clean cycles) as of this run. Full prior occurrence list (re-derive from /api/history?hours=240 when next relevant): 1320, 1323, 1327-1328, 1330, 1333, 1342-1345, 1354-1355, 1363, 1366, 1378, 1382, 1385, 1389-1390, 1392, 1414, 1438, 1450. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py lines 208-210 catching Exception and returning bare str(e), which is empty for some exception types): most recently traced on ESTAT at cycle 1449. No new occurrence this run. Previously seen on ABS (cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407, 1449), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). Still unfixed; recommend logging repr(e) or type(e).__name__ instead of str(e) so the next occurrence is diagnosable.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1456 (confirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 162 as of this run (unchanged from last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. No contract-only degraded state occurred this run to re-confirm it, but the bug itself is unfixed.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped) when the endpoint is otherwise healthy; encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time across endpoints, verdict stays ok.
